[USER] User expressed curiosity about the influences on Latin music.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Latin music has been influenced by a variety of cultures and genres, including African rhythms, Indigenous music, European classical music, jazz, and rock/pop music.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] African rhythms contributed to the development of Afro-Latino music, including styles like salsa, cumbia, and merengue.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Indigenous music has impacted Latin music, particularly in Mexico and Peru, with traditional instruments like the quena, charango, and zampoña.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] European classical music has inspired many Latin composers, influencing genres like tango and bossa nova.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Jazz influenced Latin music in the 1940s and 1950s, leading to the development of Latin jazz.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Rock and pop music from the U.S. and Europe have influenced Latin American music since the 1960s, resulting in genres like Latin rock and pop salsa.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The diverse cultural influences have made Latin music one of the most vibrant and dynamic genres in the world.
